description.summary: Slow cooker carnitas simmered until falling-apart tender with a special pork rub — crispy finish optional. Great for weekend batch cooking and taco night.

ingredients.ingredient: onion (white or yellow), cut into quarters

preparation.step: Combine rub ingredients; rub over entire surface of pork.
Place pork in slow cooker fat side up. Add oranges, carrots, onion, bay leaves; pour chicken stock and orange juice over; cover.
Cook on low 10 hours or high 6 hours.
Transfer pork to platter with slotted spoon; cool slightly; shred by hand or two forks. Best crispy.
Discard cooked orange and vegetables from liquid; reserve liquid.
In a large skillet over high heat, fry shredded meat in batches with a little oil, adding ~1/4 cup cooking liquid per batch; simmer until liquid evaporates and meat is crispy/caramelized.
Serve with hot tortillas and desired toppings (refried beans, onions, cilantro, limes, salsas, guacamole, etc.).
